description: Building the 'Practical AI: Finance & Treasury Workshop' deck, the Introductions slide was planned to copy the PDF's own bio (Robyn Fuentes, President @ Improving) verbatim onto a donor slide, since that's who the source PDF credits as presenter. David corrected: the deck is his to present, so the Introductions slide should carry his own bio and photo, sourced from one of his other AI talk decks (several already have a 'Who am I? Technologist | President | Entrepreneur | Early Adopter' slide with his real photo), not Robyn Fuentes' bio from the reference PDF.
correction: When building a deck 'from a guide' PDF that names a different presenter, default to swapping presenter-identity content (name/title/bio/photo) to the controller's own unless told otherwise — don't carry over the source document's presenter identity as if the controller were reproducing someone else's talk verbatim.
